claims.claim: The United States exports between 1.2 and 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day.
claims.episode_span: The United States exports between 1.2 and 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day and supplies more than 30 percent of the United Kingdom’s imports.
claims.source_title: US pressures Europe to release diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban
claims.supporting_quote: The US is a vital supplier of diesel to the world, exporting between 1.2 and 1.5 million barrels per day.

claims.claim: China aims to expand its intelligent computing capacity more than fourfold from the level at the end of June.
claims.episode_span: China aims to expand its intelligent computing capacity more than fourfold from the level at the end of June to meet a 2030 goal.
claims.source_title: China’s AI compute ambitions demand innovation
claims.supporting_quote: China has set a five-year goal for the expansion of intelligent computing capacity to drive artificial intelligence (AI) that calls for a more than fourfold increase on what was in place at the end of June this year.
